emails.contact_name: Apple Media Helpline (cc: Michelle Del Rio, Starlayne Meza)
emails.subject: Semafor request: Apple's AI performance claims for the new Mac mini
emails.body:
Hello,

My name is Grace Thomas, I'm a reporter with Semafor. I am writing to request comment on Apple's announcement of the new Mac mini with the all-new M6 and M5 Pro chips. I am looking for a statement on the AI claims in that announcement: how Apple arrived at up to 4x faster AI performance, what investment in silicon and Apple Intelligence sits behind it, and what always-on agentic computing means for the enterprise customers the release describes.

My deadline is 3 pm ET today.
